newsitem.title: USA: Microware's system powers WebRef platform.
newsitem.headline: Microware's system powers WebRef platform.

text.p: Microware Systems Corp, a system software developer, said Monday its Internet OS-9 system software is powering Motorola Inc's WebRef reference platform for Internet access.
It said the Internet OS-9-powered WebRef will be unveiled this week at trade shows in Boston, Los Angeles and Hannover, Germany.

Microware said Internet OS-9 facilitates rapid development of Internet-ready consumer and professional products, such as web televisions, set-top boxes and network computers. The company is shipping beta versions with web browser options.
